    "        ym, mm_inv = mulinv(mod, MOD // mod)\n" +
    "        if ym < 0: ym += MOD // mod\n" +
    "        X += REM * ym * (MOD // mod) % MOD\n" +

    "    return ym, mm_inv\n" +
    "def lcm(a: int, b: int) -> int:\n" +
    "    if a > b: return a // gcd(a, b) * b\n" +
    "    else: return b // gcd(b, a) * a\n" +
